content_data.project_description: Development of a real-time synchronization engine to enable seamless cross-platform gameplay and persistent player state across mobile, console, and PC platforms. This system will reduce player friction and support the company's multi-platform expansion strategy.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1: Architecture & Prototyping (months 1-4), Phase 2: Core Development (months 5-10), Phase 3: Integration & Testing (months 11-14)
objectives: Design scalable architecture supporting 5 million concurrent players across European servers
Implement conflict resolution mechanisms for offline-to-online transitions
Establish comprehensive monitoring and observability framework for sync operations
Reduce platform-specific code duplication by 60% through unified API layer
deliverables: Technical architecture documentation and API reference guides
Automated testing suite covering edge cases and failure scenarios
Real-time synchronization engine with WebSocket and gRPC support
Distributed state management system with Redis and PostgreSQL backend
resources_needed: Code repository and CI/CD pipeline infrastructure
4 Senior Backend Engineers with distributed systems experience
Database clustering setup with Redis Enterprise and PostgreSQL replication
1 QA Engineer specializing in performance and load testing
Monitoring and observability tools including Datadog or New Relic licenses

memory_deletes.removed_item: Enable real-time synchronization of game state across all supported platforms with sub-100ms latency
Cloud infrastructure budget for development, staging, and testing environments
